items.title: What Was Cisco Telling You Before Its Stock Ran?
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock returned 62% in the twelve months to September 24, 2026, against 16% for the S&P 500. A $10,000 holding at the start was worth about $16,220 at the end. The run was about AI data center orders from hyperscalers, the largest cloud companies. You could have read the run early only if two things held: Cisco was saying it, and its results were showing it.

items.title: Technology Stocks Are Back, Because Nothing Else Is
items.summary: A month ago, only seven technology stocks appeared in the IBD 50 and none in the top 25, as the outlook for artificial intelligence dimmed.  Today, tech stocks are back in force with the likes of Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices, Palantir and Taiwan Semiconductor showing up on the list.  In fact, Technology and Communications Services are the only two S&P sectors higher in September, while others nurse losses of about 2% to 6%.

items.title: Is Arista Networks Stock Too Dependent On Demand Holding Up?
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) ended fiscal Q2 2026 with about $9.7 billion of multi-year purchase commitments. These are promises to buy from its suppliers over several years. If demand for its switches slows, those promises remain. Will the company's sales keep pace with what it has promised its suppliers.
